notes: Three own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The pricing URL https://www.wrike.com/price/ redirected to /price-vag/; the page carries the full plan cards (Free, Team, Business, Pinnacle, Apex) and a note that its pricing is valid for purchases on or after January 21, 2026, before the capture date. The 7|ChatGPT|1 line is split: capacity planning and budgeting on Pinnacle or Apex are settled (C04), bookings are not stated by plan on any page read (C05, unverifiable). No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Not coded: 'best for teams of five to an unlimited number of users' (q5 Claude runs 1 to 3), framed as a best-for fit line; 'extensive integrations' and 'enterprise-grade security' with no named product or certification; hedged 'often requires higher-tier plans' (q7 Google AI Overviews run 2); feature descriptions (workload charts, bookings as a capability, risk forecasting, cross-tagging). Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser read exists for Wrike and no page was blocked or thin, so nothing was re-classed; C05 stays unverifiable after re-checking all three snapshots. The seven gap lines are best-for lines, unnamed integrations and security, or AI capability descriptions, all out of scope. The comparison tables (q1 to q7) give Wrike only best-for, view and feature cells (Kanban, Gantt, Table; ticks and stars), so no claim or instance was added. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
